name: Essence of Nightlash
summary: At the Dead Fields, Nightlash's defeat leaves a trace the Forsaken can carry away. High Executor Hadrec needs it as proof that the Scourge force behind the rot hide gnolls has been broken.

sections.title: The Banshee of the Dead Fields
sections.body: At the abandoned farmstead called the Dead Fields in northern Silverpine, packs of undead rot hide gnolls have dug in under Scourge command. Forsaken assaults have failed again and again, not because of the feral gnolls, but because their spectral commander, Nightlash, turns them back. Her wailing magic strengthens the gnoll lines and routs forces sent from the Sepulcher. When Nightlash is slain, her incorporeal form dissolves into dust, leaving a crystalline magical essence behind.

sections.title: Proof of Scourge Defeat
sections.body: Banshees leave no bodily corpse, so Nightlash's essence is the only physical proof that the spirit has been destroyed. High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher needs it to confirm that the Scourge foothold has fallen. With that proof, the Forsaken can secure their northern perimeter and suppress the rot hide threat.

faq.q: What is the Essence of Nightlash?
faq.answer: The Essence of Nightlash is the crystalline dust left when the Scourge banshee Nightlash is defeated. Since spirits have no physical bodies, the residue proves her destruction.
Nightlash is a Scourge banshee who commands and strengthens the rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields in northern Silverpine.
High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher wants the essence as proof that Nightlash, who routed his frontline assaults, has been defeated.

faq.q: Why are the gnolls working with a banshee?
faq.answer: The rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields have succumbed to the undead plague and become Scourge thralls. Nightlash was sent to oversee them and lend magical support against Forsaken patrols.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know why soldiers see the destruction of banshees like Nightlash as vital work. Once victims of Scourge domination, the Forsaken fight the Lich King's agents to secure Lordaeron for their own people.
As a mage, you may study the residue of destroyed banshees to learn how spectral undead tether necrotic magic to the physical world.
